effects.functionDeclaration: function(val){ var el=this,sel=null,opt=null; if(el.tagName==='SELECT'){sel=el;} else if(el.tagName==='OPTION'){opt=el; sel=el.closest('select');} if(!sel) return {ok:false,err:'<select>/option 요소가 아닙니다'}; if(!opt){ var opts=Array.from(sel.options); opt=opts.find(function(o){return o.value===val||o.textContent.trim()===val;}); } if(!opt) return {ok:false,err:'옵션을 찾을 수 없음: '+val}; sel.value=opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,selected:opt.textContent.trim(),value:opt.value}; }
